why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Gary Sánchez is slot #3 (4.386 expected team runs/game).
Slots #3, #6, #7, #5, #4, #2, #8, #1, #9 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #4 ranks 5 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.003 R/G.
Slot #3 yields 4.45 expected PA/game vs 4.35 at primary slot #4. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
